testNodeEquals.note: Jena's LiteralLabelFactory keeps "xyz"@en and "xyz"@EN apart at this level; @factoidal/core lowercases the tag, so the two are one term. Jena itself treats them as one Node (testCreateLanguagedLiteralEN2).
